name: Fan-Out 250K (5 min)
comments: 5-minute variant of Fan-Out-5-1000-5-250K.json, for quick cross-broker comparison.
5 publishers, 5 topics, 1000 subscribers each subscribed to all 5 topics.
Publish rate 50/s per publisher = 250/s in, delivered as 250/s x 1000 = 250k/s out.
The inbound side is trivial; what this measures is delivery fan-out - one received
Duration-bound rather than message_count-bound: the parent scenario stops after 1000
published messages (1M deliveries), which at this rate lasts only seconds. Dropping
message_count makes duration_sec govern, matching the Fan-In and Point-To-Point
Connections are paced at 5000/s. A thousand clients are no burst, so this changes nothing
here - it is declared so that every scenario states its ramp rather than leaving the
reader to work out which ones have one.
